title: Toro Calican
subtitle: Bounty Hunter
description: As a new and inexperienced bounty hunter on Tatooine, Toro Calican thought he could take shortcuts into the fame of notoriety by teaming with a more experienced bounty hunter, like The Mandalorian Din Djarin. When he double-crossed Mando, hoping to take the reward for Grogu, he found very quickly that turning on a Mandalorian was a lethal and foolish mistake.
